# CBAM Embedded Emissions: Cannot Be Calculated Yet

**Status: Calculation not performed. The country of production is missing.**

## Input check

| Required input | Provided | Status |
|---|---|---|
| (a) CN code in table | 7207 11 90 (Semi-finished products of iron or non-alloy steel) | ✅ Found in table |
| (b) Country of production | Not stated. The email says it is on the mill certificate, which was not included. | ❌ Missing |
| (c) Quantity (tonnes) | 3,300 t | ✅ Provided |

## Why I stopped

Under the ruleset, default SEE values depend on both the CN code and the country. CN 7207 11 90 has a different value for each listed country:

| Country | Default SEE (tCO2e/t) |
|---|---|
| Türkiye | 3.087 |
| China | 3.314 |
| India | 4.32 |

Without the country, I cannot select the correct factor. The ruleset says not to estimate when a required input is missing, so I have not picked a country or reported a total.

## What's needed to proceed

Please send the **country of production** from the mill certificate.
- If it is **Türkiye, China, or India**, I will calculate: SEE × 3,300 t, rounded half-up to 2 decimal places.
- If it is **any other country**, the table has no default value for this good and country, and the calculation cannot be done under this ruleset.
